responsibility: This file implements the default-character I/O layer mapped onto standard input, output, and error for the mc-boot runtime. It routes single-character reads and writes through FIO's standard streams, optionally bypasses buffering with raw libc read/write on file descriptors 0-2, tracks EOF/raw mode state per default descriptor, and uses termios wrappers to switch between buffered and unbuffered modes and to control terminal echo, making it the terminal-facing bridge beneath StdIO.
same_name_distinction: Implements the default stdin/stdout/stderr character I/O layer declared in GIO.h, including per-fd raw/EOF state, direct libc byte I/O, FIO stream bridging, and termios mode/echo switching.
